description: Draw a candlestick (OHLC) chart of prices: open, high, low and close for each period. For a simple price trend use generate_line_chart. Returns a hosted PNG link, a share page, alt text and editable PowerPoint/Excel links.

brandTheme.description: Name of a brand theme saved on the user's account (their colours and footer), only when the user asks for their theme. Or "colorblind" for colours that people with colour-vision deficiency can tell apart (anyone can use it).

data.description: One row per period: {time, open, high, low, close}.

name: generate_candlestick_chart
title: Candlestick chart
